about.summary: Technical Head at Nexenova Studios, building studio infrastructure and leading cross-functional teams across game design, development, and production.

highlights: Establish the studio's development infrastructure and workflows; manage cross-functional teams across the full game development lifecycle, alongside technical leadership.
Lead projects from game ideation and gameplay planning through prototyping, validation, and production, coordinating delivery across casual, action, strategy, and multiplayer genres.
Evaluate game ideas and playable prototypes for player enjoyment, gameplay quality, technical feasibility, and market potential to inform development priorities.
Define and document game mechanics and game design specifications; translate GDDs into implementation plans, sprint milestones, and coordinated team deliverables.
Plan game economies and build economy spreadsheets for projects in development, including Rubble Rivals and Relic Rivals.
Lead and mentor Unity development and game design teams, establishing engineering standards, architectural guidelines, and review workflows.
Architect scalable gameplay, backend integration, multiplayer communication, and progression systems; optimize runtime performance, memory usage, assets, and builds.
Designed a sustainable architecture for the socket and API layer of a live real-money product.
Built tools and pipelines that cut the team’s iteration time.
Cut download size with Cloud Content Delivery and Addressables; 20% improvement in app response time.
Launched Underground Waifus, an NFT TCG, on Steam, Epic Games Store and Android — 25% reduction in loading times.
Implemented locomotion for players, bots and creatures, designed for network synchronisation and reuse across actor types.
Built MOBA and battle-royale mechanics for 5v5, and the play-to-earn systems behind them.
Built multiplayer Ludo and the card game Court Piece for internal product integration; shipped Chess to Google Play.
Solved the turn-based multiplayer problems that actually bite: auto moves, turn indicators and the UI state around them.
Integrated Photon, Socket.IO, PlayFab and Firebase across the titles.
Shipped Beat Killer to Google Play: a rhythm game with no tapping, 30+ songs and 20+ dynamic backgrounds.
Researched genre demographics and market data to settle the gameplay direction before building it.
Integrated Firebase, the Facebook and Google SDKs, and AdMob.
